subject: Invite journey — multilevel touch plan for LLM inference webinar
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <events@brightwave.co>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invite journey — multilevel touch plan for LLM inference webinar

Hi team / Samantha,

Putting the invite plan draft in your inbox for the June 15 webinar: *Reducing Token Cost & Latency: Practical Inference Patterns for Product Teams*. Goal: 800+ registrants with a 25% demo conversion target for Q3 pipeline.

High-level ask: please review the segments, cadence, and sample copy below; BrightWave, can you confirm you can execute the two-step RSVP + calendar-add flow and progressive reminders? Need final creative/links by EOD Tuesday (5/25).

Segments & cadence (proposed)
- Segment A: Product/ML Engineers (primary) — TOF invite + 2 reminders + 1 last-chance (3 total sends)
- Segment B: Platform/Infra (secondary) — TOF invite + 1 reminder (2 sends)
- Segment C: Executive/Decision Makers (targeted) — Concierge invite + one reminder (1–2 touches)
- Cold/Prospect nurture list — condensed 2-touch only (invite + reminder)

Tracking & links
- RSVP link (HubSpot form): https://go.redwood.ai/rsvp-llm-inference?utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=llm-inference-202706
- Calendar add (ics generated via BrightWave) — required after RSVP
- UTM mandate: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=llm-inference-202706, utm_content={segment}

Subject line tests (A/B)
A: Cut inference cost by 40% — A practical playbook
B: How top teams ship low-latency LLM features (free webinar)

TOF invite copy (short)
Subject: {A/B}
Preview: Tactics from production teams to lower token spend and shave latency
Body (snippet): Join Redwood Inference on June 15 for a 45-minute walkthrough of real production patterns — batching, prefix caching, routing, and quantization tradeoffs. Speakers: Olivia Park (Prod Lead, Red), Dr. Amit Rao (Serving Research). RSVP to save your seat.

Reminders cadence
- Reminder 1: 4 days after send — highlight agenda + speakers
- Reminder 2: 1 day before — last chance + calendar CTA
- Post-webinar: recording + eval survey (separate flow)

Attachments: [Attachment: final_invite_timeline.pdf] (timeline + channel map)

Please reply with any copy changes, segment tweaks, or tracking updates.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Events & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <events@brightwave.co>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invite journey — multilevel touch plan for LLM inference webinar

Ben — thanks for the solid draft. A few quick notes:

- Can we tighten Segment A to Product Engineers with 1–3yrs LLM experience + Platform Engineers with >3yrs? That targeting drove better registration quality in April.
- For execs, suggest a short concierge email from Carol (VP Revenue) rather than the generic TOF copy — higher open/attend.
- Reminders: can we cap sends per contact at 3 across all sequences to avoid fatigue?

Also: our HubSpot daily send limit will be hit if we run full-blast across all segments. Grace — can you model a roll rate for the first 48 hours so we don't blow quota?

On creatives: the TOF copy looks good; I prefer Subject B for engineers and Subject A for execs.

LGTM otherwise — pending BrightWave on the calendar flow.

Laura Bennett
Demand Gen Manager | Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <events@brightwave.co>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invite journey — multilevel touch plan for LLM inference webinar

Looping in a couple of quick ops tweaks — quoted inline: 

> Reminders cadence
> - Reminder 1: 4 days after send — highlight agenda + speakers
> - Reminder 2: 1 day before — last chance + calendar CTA
> - Post-webinar: recording + eval survey (separate flow)

Suggested change: add a short mid-cycle micro-touch (48 hours after send) for Product Engineers only: one bullet list of concrete takeaways (makes the invite feel tactical). Keep the 1-day-before as the final push for all segments.

Creative changes (copy edits)
- TOF engineers: replace "batching" line with "continuous batching and KV cache strategies" (more tangible)
- Add a short CTA button copy: "Reserve your seat — add to calendar" (this triggers the 2-step flow)

Tracking: I'll generate a roll-rate model and post the sheet to Drive. We should stagger sends across US timezones: 9am local send for better open rates.

Attaching a lightweight GIF for the calendar CTA — [Attachment: calendar_cta_gif.gif].

Grace O'Connor
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <events@brightwave.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invite journey — multilevel touch plan for LLM inference webinar

Hi Ben/Laura/Grace — thanks for the brief. BrightWave can implement the two-step RSVP + calendar-add flow and the 48-hour micro-touch for Product Engineers. A few logistics/questions: 

1) Final attendee list format: will you provide segmented CSVs (email, first, last, company, persona tag)? We can handle merges and personalization.
2) ICS/calendar file: we can host an add-to-calendar endpoint, but we need the final event times and timezone cutoffs by EOD 5/25.
3) Creative: confirm we want animated GIF embedded vs. hosted image (GIF increases deliverability risk). We recommend hosted image + linked calendar CTA for deliverability.

Deadlines we need to hit to keep the June 15 launch: final copy & creative — Tue 2027-05-25 EOD; final lists & HubSpot tracking spec — Wed 2027-05-26 EOD.

Samantha Lee
Events Producer | BrightWave Events
